The PWM carrier submodule passes such a PWM signal through a transformer by using a high frequency carrier to modulate the signal.
The following key characteristics of this submodule are configurable:
Pulse width of the first pulse
Duty cycle of the second and the subsequent pulses
The PWM carrier clock (PC_clk) is derived from PWM_clk.
The frequency and duty cycle are configured by the MCPWM_CARRIER
The purpose of one-shot pulses is to provide high-energy impulse to reliably turn on the power switch.
Subsequent pulses sustain the power-on status.
The width of a one-shot pulse is configurable with the MCPWM_CARRIER
Enabling/disabling of the carrier submodule is done with the MCPWM_CARRIER

c.v: After issuing the first one-shot pulse, the remaining PWM signal is modulated according to the carrier frequency.
Users can configure the duty cycle of this signal.
Tuning of duty may be required, so that the signal passes through the isolating transformer and can still operate (turn on/off) the motor drive, changing rotation speed and direction.
